top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §744.3501(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This was re-cited when the operation has not yet received a daycare fire inspection as required.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §744.605(15))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children with allergies had incomplete FARE forms as they were missing one medication listed for each child by the physician.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §744.3559(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection it was found that the drills were not documented.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements-Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram (26 TAC §744.401(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation did not have emergency evacuation and relocation diagram posted.

top_violation_types.title: Posting-Requirements -Food Allergy Emergency Plan (26 TAC §744.401(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child that has a diagnosed food allergy did not have their names and allergy listed in the allergy and medication list.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.
